rules.statement: a contact is saved with a name

examples.text: an operator saves a contact named Dana Ruiz
the contact card shows the name and email
a contact with an empty name is saved

rules.statement: a contact is visible only inside its workspace

examples.text: an operator lists their workspace's contacts
an operator in workspace B sees a workspace A contact in the list
an operator in workspace B reads a workspace A contact by its address
a saved contact carries the operator's workspace
an operator switching workspaces sees only the new workspace's contacts

rules.statement: an email belongs to one contact per workspace

examples.text: a second contact with `dana@example.com` is refused
a contact saved with no phone is kept

rules.statement: contacts import from a CSV file

examples.text: a CSV of two contacts imports both
Ana Ortiz is listed before Ben Lee
the export holds every contact's name and email
